title: Closeout summary: Re-key directive registry by gap code and delete appliesTo matcher
body:
Subject: work:bw_work_f8bec47babe97008
Status: verified
Priority: high

## Outcome

WHY: registry entries currently predict enforcement with appliesTo predicates (packages/core/src/agent-directive-registry.ts lines 57-61 for example blocked.resolve-blockers firing on workStatuses blocked), duplicating what deriveReadinessStatus and applyRequiredCloseoutGatePolicy already know. WHAT: restructure each registry entry to be keyed by one or more EnforcementGap codes from sprint 2; the entry carries instruction text, a mandatory nextCommand template (a directive that cannot name its command is documentation, not a directive - flag any entry that cannot and raise with the owner rather than inventing), audience, and a typed data slot contract matching the gap payload. Delete the appliesTo predicate model. Migrate the existing families (blocked, verification, review, audit, git, closeout, doctor, memory, handoff, container, phase, sprint, workflow_next) by mapping each to its gap codes; workflow_next and memory families have no enforcement gap - key those off explicit advisory gap codes emitted by their commands rather than keeping a second matching path. Keep the registry a checked-in constant with the same version discipline (AGENT_DIRECTIVE_REGISTRY_VERSION) and preserve the instruction-text safety boundary from docs/architecture/AGENT_DIRECTIVES.md verbatim.

## Evidence

- bw_evidence_929a0cf7dca3e484: passed Implementation checkpoint 2ed725e0c652ed90caddcb2d2924149ad31c953a re-keyed the directive registry by trigger gap codes, removed directive-scope appliesTo matching, added nextCommandTemplate coverage, and updated schemas/docs/tests. Validation passed: git diff --check; pnpm check; focused directive/runtime vitest suite; directive-scope rg appliesTo returned no matches.
- bw_evidence_76760309b83f458f: passed Review passed for checkpoint 2ed725e0c652ed90caddcb2d2924149ad31c953a. Reviewed directive registry/compiler/schema/docs/test changes for the requested inversion: registry entries use triggerCodes and nextCommandTemplate, directive-scope appliesTo predicates are removed, advisory trigger codes cover workflow_next and memory paths, and runtime/CLI data guards prevent false checkpoint and closeout directives.

## Verification

- bw_verification_edb80671e822ccfd: passed Verified checkpoint 2ed725e0c652ed90caddcb2d2924149ad31c953a against the acceptance criteria: directive registry no longer uses appliesTo predicates, entries are keyed by triggerCodes with nextCommandTemplate, advisory trigger codes cover workflow_next and memory, and validation passed via git diff --check, pnpm check, focused directive/runtime vitest suite, and directive-scope appliesTo grep.
